title: REAL WORKOUTS.
description: Iron Spirit Gym is built for real people in Kokar, Ranchi who want to stay fit and build strength. No complicated fluff — just quality weights, guided machines, attentive trainers who correct your form, and an energetic unisex environment.

features.title: Beginner-Friendly Support
features.description: Never feel lost in the gym. Our floor trainers help you learn proper exercise techniques, correct lifting postures, and give you a structured daily routine from day one.

features.title: Complete Equipment Setup
features.description: Everything you need for full-body progression — wide dumbbell range, squat stands, bench presses, lat pulldowns, leg press, cable crossover, and cardio treadmills.

features.title: Respectful Unisex Environment
features.description: A clean, safe, and positive atmosphere where male and female members train comfortably with good ventilation and energetic workout music.

gallery.alt: Clean and equipped unisex gym floor
